envelope.description: Simplify vscode-plugin's createDaemonLifecycleController.run('update'): drop the install(true) pre-emption

body.title: Simplify vscode-plugin's createDaemonLifecycleController.run('update'): drop the install(true) pre-emption
body.summary: Remove run('update')'s special-case that detects an unmanaged-but-present install and calls install(true) (spawning the bundled signed installer). run('update') always spawns the resolved daemon-ctl.sh with 'update', delegating the managed/unmanaged decision to the now-fixed script from t1.
acceptanceChecks: run('update') on an unmanaged install always spawns 'bash <daemon-ctl.sh> update', never the bundled installer.
run('update') on a managed install is unchanged.

tests.name: vscode-plugin/src/daemon/__tests__/controller.test.ts: 'The VS Code update action selects the installer on legacy macOS and the selected controller after migration' (replaced with an assertion that update always spawns daemon-ctl.sh update, unmanaged or managed)
